source_prompt: Nighttime view of an old mystical shop facade with ornate wooden architecture. A large dark blue sign reads 'Stasis Spells Locked Fusions'. Below it is a heavy wooden door covered in white runes, secured with multiple locks and a large eye-shaped padlock. A framed painting above the door shows a boy in a blue coat reading a book, while two ghostly female faces with flowing hair watch him from behind a gate. Potion bottles containing swirling blue liquid and miniature faces are displayed in the window and on shelves. Old papers and notes are pinned to the walls, lantern light illuminates the scene, dark blue and purple color palette, atmospheric and mysterious fantasy style.
